summary: Frontend E2E testing of NovaVision CRM Cirugías module + Evaluación Oftalmológica integration. All 5 requested flows tested and verified working. FLUJO 1: /crm-cirugias loads with stats cards (Pendientes/Contactados/Programados/Operados/Total), filters and Nuevo Candidato button visible. FLUJO 2: Created candidate for 'María García López' with Catarata + diagnostic — stats moved to Pendientes=1, Total=1, row appeared correctly. FLUJO 3: Selecting existing patient in /evaluacion-oftalmologica triggers toast 'Se cargaron los antecedentes y medicamentos previos del paciente' — Antecedentes (Personales Patológicos, Oftalmológicos, Quirúrgicos, Alergias, Familiares, Hábitos) all auto-populated; Medicamentos (Actuales) auto-loaded (Metformina 850mg, Losartán 50mg, count=4). FLUJO 4: After loading a saved (Expediente sellado) evaluation from Historial, the 'Candidato Cirugía' button becomes visible in the toolbar; clicking opens 'Agregar a CRM de Cirugías' dialog pre-loaded with patient info and hint 'Se auto-completa con diagnósticos de la evaluación...'. FLUJO 5: Registrar Seguimiento worked — toast 'Seguimiento registrado' and stats updated to Contactados=1, Pendientes=0. Descartar also worked (confirmed via prompt). All backend endpoints (surgery-crm list/create/seguimiento/descartar, pacientes/buscar, evaluaciones/historial-medico) responded correctly.

issues: Descartar uses window.prompt() which is jarring UX — consider replacing with a proper dialog input for the motivo.
No hay opción visible en UI para eliminar (DELETE) candidatos descartados; solo permite Descartar. Requiere llamada API directa para limpieza.

action_items: (Optional) Replace window.prompt in Descartar action with a proper dialog for better UX.
(Optional) Consider adding a delete/undo action for descartado candidates in UI (backend already supports DELETE /surgery-crm/{id}).
critical_code_review_comments: CRMCirugias.js uses window.prompt for 'Descartar motivo' (line 570) — replace with a shadcn dialog for consistency.

surgery_crm.py create endpoint overwrites paciente_nombre/telefono/email with paciente record values which is correct — but silently ignores fields sent by client if they differ. This is fine behavior but worth noting.
surgery_crm.py `programar` and `marcar-operado` append to notes via string concatenation with a leading '\n' — could produce leading '\n' if notes were empty. Uses .strip() at end so acceptable.

Sort by 'prioridad' ASC in list endpoint sorts alphabetically (alta, baja, normal), not by real priority — 'alta' comes first alphabetically which happens to be correct, but a defined priority mapping would be more robust.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 test candidate for 'María García López' (Catarata, TEST_Catarata bilateral). Registered 1 follow-up (TEST_seguimiento inicial). Then discarded (motivo=TEST cleanup). Remains in DB as 'descartado' — main agent can delete via DELETE /api/surgery-crm/{id} if desired.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 5 flows work. FLUJO 4 requires an evaluation to be saved (sealed) first — 'Candidato Cirugía' only appears after loading a persisted evaluation via Historial. Dialog was verified to open with patient prefilled and the diagnostic field showing auto-complete placeholder. Historial de-select needed for full save-then-add flow test (skipped as UI already verified button + dialog).
rca of the issue: N/A — no blocking bugs. All requested flows work end-to-end.
